title: The Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art
summary: A Han-dynasty Chinese mathematical text of 246 problems in nine chapters, giving computational procedures without Greek-style proofs for surveying, grain, proportion, engineering and right triangles. Its date is debated, from about 200 BCE to about 179 CE; Liu Hui wrote his commentary on it in 263.

uncertainty.note: MacTutor: most historians think about 200 BC; others 100 BC to 50 AD; evidence for different parts runs 206 BC to 50 AD. EBSCO: completed around 179 C.E. Range covers both.
